strings.title: The Final Tasting
strings.hint: Not every death is caused by poison. Look for the fatal allergy, then ask: who knew the secret medical history before anyone else?
strings.solvedText:
The killer: Talal Rustam — the owner of the rival restaurant.

He had been the victim's business partner before their falling-out, making him the only person outside the kitchen's circle who knew the critic's dangerous secret: a fatal peanut allergy that he concealed to protect his professional reputation. Attending the tasting as guest of honor, he took a courtesy tour of the kitchen and slipped concentrated peanut extract into the finishing oil. He wanted to bring down the critic whose harsh review had destroyed his restaurant, while framing his rival chef for murder — two targets with one dish.

The evidence against him: the extract receipt, kitchen footage placing him by the serving trolley, and messages from their old partnership revealing his knowledge of the allergy.
strings.summary.text: At a private tasting for a restaurant pursuing its second star, critic Samer Haddad — the sharpest tongue in the city — collapsed immediately after the fifth course and died before the ambulance arrived. Tests found no conventional poison, but a severe allergic reaction to peanut traces in a dish whose recipe contained none. In the kitchen that night: a chef with wounded pride, a trainee with a hidden past, and a guest of honor who owned the rival restaurant.
strings.summary.photoCap: The tasting table after the dining room was evacuated
strings.summary.victim.name: Samer Haddad
strings.summary.victim.job: Restaurant critic — his column makes and breaks reputations
strings.scene.address: Lumière restaurant — private dining room and kitchen
strings.scene.intro: The fifth course contained no nuts, but the finishing oil drizzled over it in front of the guests carried concentrated peanut traces. The critic's emergency auto-injector was missing from his bag.
strings.scene.photos[0].cap: The fifth course and finishing oil
strings.scene.notes[0]: Concentrated peanut traces found only in the finishing oil
strings.scene.notes[1]: Epinephrine auto-injector missing from the victim's bag
strings.scene.notes[2]: Guest of honor toured the kitchen ten minutes before the course
strings.scene.notes[3]: Chef publicly threatened the critic a month earlier
strings.evidence[0].title: Finishing oil bottle
strings.evidence[0].desc: Concentrated peanut extract had recently been added — an amount intended to trigger a fatal reaction.
strings.evidence[1].title: Missing auto-injector
strings.evidence[1].desc: The critic never went anywhere without it. Its disappearance suggests the killer knew about the allergy and planned to prevent a rescue.
strings.evidence[2].title: Kitchen camera still
strings.evidence[2].desc: The guest of honor stands beside the serving trolley for 12 seconds during his courtesy tour.
strings.evidence[3].title: Confidential medical file
strings.evidence[3].desc: The peanut allergy is documented but secret — known only to a few people from his past.
strings.evidence[4].title: Chef's published threat
strings.evidence[4].desc: 'I'll make him eat his words' — a notorious remark after the devastating review of his first restaurant.
strings.evidence[5].title: Nut extract receipt
strings.evidence[5].desc: A cash purchase two days earlier, using a loyalty card registered to the rival restaurant.
strings.suspects[0].name: Chef Bassem Alwan
strings.suspects[0].relation: The critic ruined his first restaurant
strings.suspects[0].alibi: 'I never left the cooking line for a moment — twenty pairs of eyes were on me.'
strings.suspects[0].statement: I hated his pen, not the man. I invited him tonight to prove he was wrong about me. If I'd wanted him dead, I wouldn't have done it in my own kitchen on my big night. The dish left my hands untouched — who handled the serving trolley after me?
strings.suspects[1].name: Trainee Rima Jabr
strings.suspects[1].alibi: 'I was washing dishes when the course was served — everyone saw me.'
strings.suspects[1].statement: I changed my name because the critic destroyed my father's restaurant five years ago and bankrupted us. I came here to learn and rebuild what we lost, not for revenge. Yes, I hid my connection to him. Which of you would have hired me if you'd known?
strings.suspects[2].name: Talal Rustam
strings.suspects[2].relation: Guest of honor — the victim's former business partner
strings.suspects[2].alibi: 'I was the guest of honor, sitting at the table in front of everyone. I even tasted the same dish.'
strings.suspects[2].statement: Samer was an old friend and my first business partner before we went our separate ways. My kitchen tour was a professional courtesy, offered by the chef himself. I tasted the same dish and nothing happened to me — what sort of poison chooses its victim?
strings.witnesses[0].name: Dining room manager
strings.witnesses[0].statement: Mr. Talal insisted on touring the kitchen specifically before the fifth course, even though the usual schedule places the tour at the end.
strings.witnesses[1].name: Suha, the waitress
strings.witnesses[1].statement: The critic's bag stayed on the next chair all evening, except for five minutes when the cloakroom attendant moved it for a guest who said it was blocking the aisle.
strings.witnesses[2].name: Sous-chef
strings.witnesses[2].statement: The finishing oil is freshly bottled an hour before service. The bottle looked as though it had been opened twice — the seal was loose.
strings.folders[0].name: Incident reports
strings.folders[0].docs[0].title: Death during the tasting
strings.folders[0].docs[0].body: An ambulance was called following a sudden collapse; the victim died before it arrived. The restaurant was closed and the kitchen cordoned off.
strings.folders[1].name: Forensic evidence
strings.folders[1].docs[0].title: Laboratory report
strings.folders[1].docs[0].body: Fatal allergic shock caused by concentrated peanut extract found exclusively in the finishing oil. The dish itself was uncontaminated.
strings.folders[1].docs[1].title: Bag examination report
strings.folders[1].docs[1].body: The epinephrine auto-injector had been hurriedly pulled from the inner pocket — the pocket stitching was torn.
strings.folders[2].name: Interviews
strings.folders[2].docs[0].title: Chef's interview
strings.folders[2].docs[0].body: Emotional but consistent. The entire team confirmed that he remained on the cooking line.
strings.folders[2].docs[1].title: Trainee's interview
strings.folders[2].docs[1].body: She voluntarily revealed her past connection to the victim and broke down in tears. Camera footage confirms her position at the sink.
strings.folders[2].docs[2].title: Guest of honor's interview
strings.folders[2].docs[2].body: He denied knowing about any allergy. When confronted with his former partnership with the victim, he fell silent and requested a lawyer.
strings.folders[3].name: Records
strings.folders[3].docs[0].title: Former partnership records
strings.folders[3].docs[0].body: A failed restaurant partnership between the victim and Talal ended in a bitter split 12 years ago. An old internal memo refers to a 'special meal plan for S.H.'s allergy.'
strings.folders[3].docs[1].title: Extract purchase record
strings.folders[3].docs[1].body: Concentrated peanut extract purchased two days before the event, using Talal's restaurant loyalty card.
strings.folders[4].name: Confidential files
strings.folders[4].docs[0].title: Final review draft
strings.folders[4].docs[0].body: Found on the victim's phone: an unpublished review awarding the chef's restaurant its second star, while describing Talal's restaurant as 'a corpse kept running by sheer stubbornness.'
strings.folders[4].docs[1].title: Auto-injector recovery report
strings.folders[4].docs[1].body: The auto-injector was found in the dining room drain directly beneath the guest of honor's table.
strings.reports[0].title: Contamination timeline report
strings.reports[0].author: Investigation team
strings.reports[0].body: The finishing oil was contaminated between bottling and service — a 40-minute window matching the guest of honor's tour. The missing auto-injector establishes premeditation.
strings.reports[1].title: Motive assessment
strings.reports[1].author: Assigned investigator
strings.reports[1].body: The chef was driven by pride and the trainee by her past. But only the guest of honor combined knowledge of the allergy, access, and a double motive.
strings.notes[0].text: Who knew about the secret allergy? The circle is smaller than it seems.
strings.notes[1].text: Missing auto-injector = the killer planned to prevent a rescue
